description: Ask the vault which of the user's own stored cards earns the most for a purchase (smart purchases). Pass the merchant name, its website when you know it, and the amount. Returns the card id to use as card_id at checkout, the reason in plain words, and the runners-up. null when smart purchases is off for this account, no stored card has been named yet (see name_card), or nothing could be said; then pay as you would have. Never a card number.

amount_cents.description: Order total in cents, when known.

currency.description: ISO currency code, default usd. Non-USD purchases account for foreign transaction fees.

merchant.description: The merchant as the user would see it, e.g. "DoorDash".

merchant_url.description: The merchant's website or checkout origin, e.g. https://www.doordash.com. Improves the category match.

name: recommend_card

alternatives.description: Other stored cards with their estimated value in cents and reason.

card_id.description: The vault card to pay with (pass as card_id at checkout), or null.

category.description: The spend category the merchant resolved to.

reason.description: Why, in one or two sentences the user can be told verbatim.
